# Zonorah, Media Neuroscience Lab

> Zonorah is a streaming media monitoring tool used in academic research, and a Media Neuroscience Lab that now opens the tool to the public by subscription.

Zonorah is the tool: a streaming media monitoring system built for academic research. It is also a Media Neuroscience Lab that encourages research by opening the tool to the public under a subscription model. Research on the brain is done separately and uses these counts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zonorah.com/): Zonorah is a streaming media monitoring tool used in academic research, and a Media Neuroscience Lab that now opens the tool to the public by subscription.
- [Method](https://zonorah.com/method/): How Zonorah records, transcribes and counts radio, TV and YouTube, what the numbers cannot tell you, and how to cite them.
- [Research](https://zonorah.com/research/): How the Zonorah lab encourages research on broadcast media: the tool by subscription, a custom report in every paid plan and studies for organisations.
- [The tool](https://zonorah.com/data/): See how many minutes a word got on radio, TV and YouTube, download the table and ask the AI assistant. A free plan and paid subscriptions.
- [Sample studies](https://zonorah.com/studies/): Ten PDF reports from one week of radio and TV in September 2026, one per sector. The reports are in Spanish.
- [Privacy](https://zonorah.com/privacy/): What Zonorah stores, what it does not store and how to delete your account. No recordings are kept.
- [Terms and refunds](https://zonorah.com/terms/): The terms of use, billing and refund rules for Zonorah plans. Draft pending legal review.
